title: UI/UX Designer (Figma)
description: UI/UX Designer (Figma) Part-time | Remote | ~20 hours/week | Long-term engagement About Us We are a mobile app development and fractional CTO consultancy that works with startups and growing businesses to build products that are technically solid and genuinely well-designed. We partner closely with our clients across the full product lifecycle, from strategy and design through to development and launch. We are growing our team and looking for a UI/UX designer who can work across multiple client projects with us on an ongoing basis. The Role We need a UI/UX designer to own Figma design work across our client projects, primarily focused on iOS mobile apps. You will work closely with our project managers, engineers, and clients to translate product ideas into clean, buildable designs that follow Apple's Human Interface Guidelines. This is not a "make it pretty" role. This is a "make it work, make it make sense, and make sure we're building the right thing" role. What You Will Actually Be Doing - Owning and maintaining Figma design systems across client projects (component libraries, color tokens, typography, spacing, corner radii) - Designing and iterating on iOS app screens across full user journeys - Translating product ideas into wireframes and high-fidelity mockups - Working within Apple's UI guidelines and using standard iOS components and libraries - Attending regular check-ins with our internal team and client stakeholders - Flagging when a design direction won't work technically or won't make sense to users - Helping the team prioritize which ideas are worth designing now vs. later What We Are Looking For On the technical side: - Strong Figma skills including component libraries, auto layout, and design tokens - Solid understanding of iOS design patterns and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines - Experience designing mobile apps, not just websites - Ability to hand off clean, organized files that an engineer can actually build from - Familiarity with design systems and how global changes (theming, sizing) work in Figma - On the personality side, this is equally important: - You are direct. If an idea won't work, you say so clearly and explain why. - You are proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You see a gap and you fill it. - You are confident enough to push back. Our clients are passionate and move fast. We need someone who can channel that energy into good design decisions, not just execute everything thrown at them. - You can tell the difference between a good idea that needs refining and an idea that needs to be set aside for now. - You communicate clearly in writing. Most of our collaboration happens async. What This Is Not This is not a role for someone who just does what they are told This is not a role for someone who needs everything figured out before they can start This is not a role for someone who treats every client idea as equally worth designing Nice to Have Experience working directly with non-technical clients or founders in a startup environment Familiarity with health, wellness, or lifestyle apps Experience designing for accessibility (contrast, font sizing, Apple accessibility standards) Logistics Remote, Philippines-based preferred Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week to start Long-term engagement if it's a good fit Payment in USD How to Apply Please send the following: Your portfolio (Figma files preferred, not just screenshots) A brief note (3-5 sentences) on how you handle it when a client asks you to design something you think is a bad idea Your availability and rate We read every application. We will not respond to applications without a portfolio.

title: *Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig*
description: *Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig* Boutique Video Production Studio — New York *About the Role* We're a boutique video production studio based in New York City, specializing in corporate image films, brand documentaries, and event films — primarily for European companies operating in the US market. We're rebuilding our website, and we need someone who understands that a studio site isn't just a portfolio — it's a sales tool. Every page has a job to do: communicate who we are, build trust with a specific type of client, and move them toward picking up the phone. We're looking for a Web Designer who leads with structure and ends with craft. Someone who opens a new project by thinking about pages, user flow, and hierarchy — not colors and typefaces. The visual execution matters enormously, but it comes last. You'll work directly with the founder on a project basis, with potential for ongoing work as we grow. You'll own the design process from sitemap to handoff, working within Wix (or Webflow if you can make a case for it). Copy and video assets will be provided — your job is to make them land. *Who You Are* You understand the web as a medium, not a canvas. You think about scroll behaviour, states, responsiveness, and hierarchy the way a developer thinks about logic: it either works or it doesn't. You're not a graphic designer who builds websites on the side. Web design is your specialism. It's where your thinking lives. *What You'll Do* You'll take ownership of the full website project from concept to launch — starting with strategy, not aesthetics. Before a single frame gets designed, you'll need to understand our brand, our clients, and our business goals. 1. Strategy & Concept • Develop the sitemap, define page hierarchy, and map out the user flow • Make deliberate structural decisions before moving into design • Understand what a service-based studio site needs to do commercially, not just visually 2. Design & Build • Design and build a 5–7 page website in Wix (including Wix Developer tools) or Webflow • Deliver fully responsive designs for both desktop and mobile — not just scaled-down versions of each other • Understand scroll behavior, interactive states, and responsiveness as logic problems, not just visual ones • Apply hierarchy the way a developer thinks: what loads first, what earns attention, what drives action 3. Conversion & SEO • Build a conversion-focused site that actively moves a visitor toward becoming a client • Implement proper SEO foundations from day one: meta titles, header structures, and technical configurations • Structure content and copy placement for both readability and search performance 4. Technical Setup • Handle hosting setup, domain transfer, and any migrations required • Deliver a clean handoff so the site is fully live and running from day one • Manage any technical configurations independently — no handholding needed *What We're Looking For* Required: • 3+ years specializing in web design — not general graphic, brand, or print design • A genuine process: sitemap ? wireframe ? visual design, every time • Strong information architecture skills — you can define page structure, navigation logic, and content hierarchy from a brief • Deep understanding of web UX: conversion logic, scroll behavior, mobile-first thinking, and interactive states • Expert-level skills in either Wix (including Wix Developer / Velo) or Webflow — tell us which one and show us what you've built with it • A portfolio of live websites for service-based businesses or creative studios that shows process, not just final output • Clear, proactive communicator in English — you flag problems early and ask the right questions *How to Apply* Send us the following: • Your portfolio — live websites only. We're not interested in Dribbble shots, unsolicited redesigns, or graphic design work. Show us websites you actually shipped. • 1–2 case studies that walk us through your process: how you structured the site, the thinking behind the page hierarchy, and how the final design connects back to the brief. The thinking matters as much as the output. Bonus points if any of them are for a creative studio, production company, or service-based business. • A short introduction: who you are, what kinds of projects you've worked on, your platform of choice (Wix or Webflow), and your rate for a project like this. Compensation • $400–600 flat project fee for the full website (5–7 pages), depending on complexity and experience • Ongoing retainer available for post-launch support, updates, and maintenance — billed hourly at a rate we agree on upfront We're looking for the best fit, not the cheapest option. If your work is strong and your process is solid, we're open to discussing rate.

title: Contracts and Client Accounts Officer
description: Position Description Contracts & Client Accounts Officer Employment Type Full-Time Reports To Operations Manager / Practice Manager Position Summary The Contracts & Client Accounts Officer is responsible for managing the contractual and financial administration of client matters from engagement through to completion. The role prepares service agreements and contract variations based on consultation outcomes and instructions provided by Registered Migration Agents (RMAs), maintains client accounts, generates invoices, monitors payments, negotiates payment arrangements, follows up outstanding accounts, reconciles client records, and issues Statements of Service upon completion of contracted services. The position plays a critical role in ensuring contractual accuracy, timely billing, effective debt collection, accurate client account management, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements while maintaining positive client relationships. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. Contract Preparation and Administration Prepare service agreements based on consultation outcomes and instructions provided by RMAs. Draft contract variations, amendments, and additional service agreements as directed by RMAs. Ensure agreements accurately reflect the approved scope of services, fees, payment schedules, and terms and conditions. Issue agreements to clients and manage contract execution processes. Explain agreement terms, payment obligations, and contract variations to clients where required. Maintain contract registers and document management systems. Store executed agreements and related documents within the client management system. Monitor contract status and ensure documentation remains complete and current. Maintain standard agreement templates and supporting documentation. 2. Client Account Management Establish and maintain client accounts upon engagement. Record agreements, variations, invoices, payments, credits, refunds, and account adjustments. Monitor client account balances and payment schedules. Maintain accurate client financial records and transaction histories. Reconcile client accounts and investigate discrepancies. Prepare client account statements and payment summaries when required. Respond to client enquiries regarding invoices, payments, balances, and contractual charges. Ensure all client account information is accurate, complete, and up to date. 3. Invoicing and Revenue Administration Generate invoices in accordance with approved agreements and contract variations. Prepare milestone, progress, and final invoices. Verify invoice accuracy prior to issue. Ensure fees charged align with contractual obligations and approved services. Maintain invoice registers and billing records. Monitor upcoming billing events and payment schedules. Coordinate with RMAs regarding additional billable services and approved variations. Ensure timely invoicing of all contracted services. 4. Accounts Receivable, Collections and Negotiations Monitor outstanding invoices and payment due dates. Follow up overdue accounts via telephone, email , and written correspondence. Issue payment reminders, demand notices, and account statements. Negotiate payment arrangements and payment plans within approved authority limits. Resolve account disputes and billing queries professionally and efficiently. Encourage timely payment while maintaining positive client relationships. Maintain records of collection activities and client communications. Monitor compliance with agreed payment arrangements. Escalate unresolved accounts to management when required. Assist with debt recovery activities where necessary. Prepare aged debtor and accounts receivable reports. Work proactively to minimise overdue accounts and improve collection performance. 5. Service Delivery Tracking Monitor client matters against contracted services, milestones, and deliverables. Liaise with RMAs and support staff regarding service progress and completion. Track approved contract variations and associated billing events. Ensure services delivered align with contractual obligations. Identify and report discrepancies between contracted and delivered services. 6. Service Completion and Matter Closure Liaise with RMAs to verify completion of contracted services. Prepare and issue Statements of Service upon completion of services. Ensure all invoices have been issued prior to matter closure. Reconcile client accounts before file closure. Issue final account statements where required. Ensure all contractual and financial records are complete and properly filed. Close client matters in accordance with company procedures. 7. Reporting and Record Keeping Maintain accurate records of contracts, variations, invoices, payments, collections, negotiations, and client accounts. Prepare weekly and monthly operational and financial reports. Monitor contract activity, revenue generation, outstanding accounts, collection performance, and payment plan compliance. Support management with reporting and business analysis. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records. 8. Compliance and Quality Assurance Ensure all documentation complies with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements. Maintain confidentiality of client information. Support internal audits and compliance reviews. Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to operational efficiency. Maintain high standards of accuracy and professionalism in all documentation and communications. Essential Qualifications Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Legal Services, Contract Administration, or a related discipline; or Equivalent demonstrated work experience. Essential Experience Minimum 2 years' experience in: Contract Administration; Client Account Management; Accounts Receivable; Finance Administration; or Professional Services Administration. Demonstrated experience: Preparing contracts, agreements, and variations. Managing client accounts and records. Generating invoices and administering billing processes. Following up outstanding accounts and collecting payments. Negotiating payment arrangements and resolving account-related issues. Maintaining accurate financial and administrative records. Working with CRM and business management systems. Managing client-facing financial discussions. Experience within a migration, legal, accounting, consulting, education, or other professional services environment. Experience using QuickBooks Online. Experience using CRM or practice management systems. Experience supporting compliance-driven service delivery environments. Essential Skills Contract Administration Ability to prepare contracts, agreements, and variations from approved templates and instructions. Strong document management and record-keeping skills. Ability to interpret instructions and accurately translate them into contractual documentation. Financial Administration Invoice generation and billing administration. Accounts receivable management. Payment allocation and reconciliation. Debt collection and account follow-up. Client account management and reporting. Negotiation and Relationship Management Strong negotiation skills. Ability to negotiate payment arrangements and collection outcomes. Ability to manage difficult conversations professionally. Ability to resolve disputes and account-related issues. Ability to influence positive outcomes while maintaining client relationships. Strong stakeholder management skills. Technical Skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams. Ability to work with CRM, accounting, and practice management systems. Experience with QuickBooks Online will be highly regarded. Strong data entry accuracy and database management skills. Communication Skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Professional client service skills. Ability to communicate contractual, financial, and account-related matters clearly and professionally. Ability to build rapport and maintain productive client relationships. Organisational Skills Strong attention to detail. Excellent time management and prioritisation skills. Ability to manage multiple client matters simultaneously. Ability to work independently while meeting deadlines. Personal Attributes Highly organised and detail-oriented. Professional and client-focused. Honest, trustworthy, and able to maintain confidentiality. Strong sense of accountability and ownership. Process-driven and committed to accuracy. Proactive and solutions-oriented. Confident and professional communicator. Tactful and diplomatic when handling sensitive financial matters. Resilient and comfortable dealing with difficult conversations. Able to negotiate effectively while maintaining professionalism and client satisfaction. Able to work effectively in a team environment. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Service agreements prepared within 24 hours of receiving RMA instructions. Contract variations prepared within 24 hours of approval. Invoice accuracy rate of 99% or higher. All invoices issued within 1 business day of becoming billable. Reduction in aged debtors and overdue accounts. Collection targets achieved each month. Payment plans monitored and maintained effectively. Accurate maintenance of client account records. Statements of Service issued within 2 business days of service completion. Compliance with company policies and quality standards. Audit-ready client files and financial records at all times. Ideal Candidate A highly organised and commercially minded professional with experience in contract administration, client account management, invoicing, collections, and financial administration. The ideal candidate possesses strong negotiation skills, is confident managing client financial discussions, and can independently manage the contractual and financial lifecycle of client matters while supporting RMAs and ensuring a professional client experience. Experience with QuickBooks Online, CRM systems, and professional services environments will be highly regarded.

Security & Telemetry: Experience implementing robust AI security layers, intent-based controls, and unified telemetry for enterprise-scale deployments.

description: This role is responsible for credentialing, enrollment, and ongoing payor maintenance with the following plans: Aetna, ASR Health Benefits, Blue Care Network (BCN), Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS), Federal Employees Health Benefits (FEHB), Medicare, MESSA, Optum, Oxford Health Plans, Priority Health, UnitedHealthcare, UM Health Plan, and Out-of-Network payors. title: Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor
job_title: Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor
description: Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor The setup . I've already got an audience and a funnel running — YouTube and Instagram content that turns into free-course signups and 30-day GoHighLevel trials. (Some of us have started calling this "Claude for Content" — you'd be the one actually running it day to day to get things made and out the door.) The ideation and the content pipeline are mine — I'm deeply involved in that part, every week. What I need is someone to take it from there: build the automations, generate the actual content with AI, get it edited, and get it posted, on time, without me having to chase it. . The role at the simplest level You're doing three things every single day. Taking the ideas and scripts that come out of our content pipeline and actually producing them — AI-generated, B-roll, whatever the format calls for. Getting each piece edited, mostly through AI tools, and out the door on schedule, whether that's an automated post or you hitting publish yourself. And repurposing what's already live into the next thing — same content, new platform, new cut. . Why I'm hiring That's the floor. The reason I'm posting this is I'm not handing off ideation — that part's staying with me and the pipeline I've already built. What I want is someone who can take a script and a hook and actually turn it into a finished, edited, posted, and repurposed piece of content without needing their hand held through it. Execution brain, every day. We'll still go through the analytics together — but production can't bottleneck on me. . Who we are I'm Vico Khang. I build and run AI automation and no-code agency systems on GoHighLevel — AI voice and chat agents, lead-gen automations, white-label SaaS — on real client accounts, not just talking about it on camera. The content side grew out of that: people kept asking how I was doing it, so I started filming it, and that turned into a real audience on Instagram and YouTube. We're not a media company that picked up automation as a topic. We're an automation business that happens to also make good content about it. Want the longer version, in my own words? Watch it here: ---------- . How to apply Fill out the doc here: ---------- . Day to day Building and maintaining the automations that move content from script to published post, cutting out manual busywork wherever it can. Generating the actual content with AI tools once a script or idea comes down the pipeline — B-roll voiceover pieces, AI-avatar or UGC-style videos, whatever the format calls for. Editing through AI tools first, and stepping in by hand only where AI can't get it there. Posting on schedule, automated where it makes sense, manual where it doesn't. Repurposing everything that goes out on YouTube or Instagram into TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook versions. Flagging anything in the calendar that needs a second look, and looping me in on the numbers — we go through those together. . What I need Real, hands-on fluency with Claude and the broader AI content stack — Gemini, Higgsfield, HeyGen — enough to take a script or idea and actually produce a finished piece with it. Comfortable building simple automations — Zapier, Make, n8n, or native tool workflows — so posting and repurposing don't need a human clicking every button. Solid editing instincts, and just as important, knowing which AI tool can do the edit for you and when it can't. Real, hands-on posting experience on YouTube and Instagram — you know the upload mechanics, scheduling, and formatting quirks of each platform cold. Comfortable repurposing long-form into short-form without needing a brief for every single cut. Decent English. We're filming for a US, UK, Canada, and Australia audience. . Bonus If you've actually run the production and distribution side of a channel — your own or someone else's — and know what breaks when you try to automate posting and repurposing, that's a big plus. . What won't work Someone who wants to own the ideation and strategy — that's staying with me and the content pipeline. Someone who treats AI tools as optional instead of the default way things get edited and produced. And someone who needs a fresh brief for every single piece instead of running the system once it's handed to them. . How to apply Fill out the doc here: ---------- Please don't send me a generic resume with nothing to show how you actually produce content with AI — I'll know within 5 seconds, and I'll just close it.

description: Job Overview We are a fast-growing, innovative brand, and we are looking for a highly capable, resourceful, and proactive Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist. You will take complete ownership of our digital footprint, from managing our presence on forums like Reddit to building a fortress of positive reviews on Trustpilot and Google, all with the ultimate goal of ensuring we show up flawlessly in AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, etc.). If you are someone who waits to be told exactly how to handle a negative brand mention or needs step-by-step instructions on review generation, this is not the role for you. We need a tactical, results-focused professional who knows how to scrub the internet of unfair negativity, drown out the noise with high-quality positive content, and engineer our brand’s narrative across the modern web. Core Responsibilities - Forum & Reddit Management: Actively monitor brand mentions across Reddit and niche forums. Strategically mitigate, suppress, or facilitate the removal of negative comments and threads (utilizing ToS flags, moderation outreach, and strategic counter-narratives). - Review Generation Mastermind: Build, execute, and manage systems to drive glowing reviews across platforms like Trustpilot, Google Reviews, Sitejabber, and industry-specific directories. - Positive Content Proliferation: Distribute positive articles, PR, blog posts, and user-generated content across high-authority sites to ensure the first page of our search results is overwhelmingly positive. - AI Search Engine Optimization: Structure and seed positive brand content across the web so that large language models (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) generate accurate, highly favorable summaries of our brand. - Monitoring & Reporting: Utilize brand monitoring tools to track sentiment, keyword visibility, and review velocity. Provide weekly updates on what’s ranking, what’s changing, and how our AI search presence is improving. Required Qualifications & Skills - Experience is Mandatory: You must have a proven track record of successfully suppressing/removing negative search results and significantly boosting positive brand sentiment. - Platform & Policy Expertise: You understand the complex ecosystems and moderation guidelines of Reddit, Trustpilot, and Google. You know the exact levers to pull to get unfair or defamatory content removed or pushed down. - SEO & AI Search Intuition: You understand how traditional search engines and new AI search tools scrape, summarize, and prioritize information. - Exceptional Communication Skills: Flawless written English. You can write persuasive outreach email s, manage forum accounts organically, and craft brand-aligned responses to customer feedback. - Proactive Problem-Solver: You naturally spot a negative link or a dip in Trustpilot score and immediately execute a multi-step plan to fix it without being asked. - Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer capable of handling multiple workflows smoothly. How to Apply: If you are sharp, highly strategic, and ready to take full ownership of our brand's digital reputation, please reply with: - A brief introduction outlining your experience specifically with Reddit reputation management and Trustpilot/Google review generation. - A brief case study or example (redacted if necessary) of a time you successfully suppressed a negative search result/thread or rapidly improved a brand's online rating.

description: Instructions to apply in the text. You must be able to maintain focus, energy, and high-quality thinking during this shift. Your work will include: Reading technical articles, product descriptions, datasheets, company websites, industry pages, and market information. Identifying what the target company likely cares about commercially and technically. Preparing short but powerful cold-call research notes. Creating smart opening statements and questions that make the customer feel we understand their business. Supporting lead research for manufacturing, industrial supply, engineering, importing/exporting, and B2B sales campaigns. Helping the calling team approach each prospect with a customized, intelligent reason for contact. Required Qualifications This role is for a serious, highly analytical person. You must have: A Master’s degree or equivalent advanced academic background. Exceptional analytical and logical thinking. Strong English reading and writing ability. Ability to read heavy technical material and summarize it clearly. Ability to connect technical product features to customer pain points. Strong business curiosity. Strong discipline and ability to work during the required overnight schedule. Reliable computer and internet connection. Ability to work independently without constant supervision. Ability to produce accurate, useful, and practical research quickly. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving difficult business research problems. You may be a good fit if you: Like reading technical or industrial material. Can understand complex topics even when they are outside your original field. Can ask, “Why does this matter to the customer?” Can turn difficult information into simple, powerful sales language. Are comfortable researching manufacturing, industrial products, engineering applications, supply chains, and U.S. market opportunities. Think logically and do not just copy/paste from websites. Read the text below: “High-vacuum fasteners are not just ‘better stainless screws.’ They are fasteners designed so they do not trap gas, shed particles, outgas oils/water/hydrocarbons, or create ‘virtual leaks’ inside a vacuum chamber. In vacuum terminology, HV is commonly around 10?³ to 10?? mbar, and UHV around 10?? to 10?¹² mbar. At those pressures, surface cleanliness and tiny trapped gas volumes start to dominate performance, so ordinary fasteners can become a real process problem. The core problem: virtual leaks. A normal screw threaded into a blind tapped hole traps a small pocket of air under the screw and along the threads. That pocket may slowly bleed gas into the chamber during pump-down. To the vacuum system, it looks like a small leak, even though there is no hole to atmosphere. This is called a virtual leak. Regular bolts inside a vacuum chamber can leave small air pockets under their threads, and those pockets can take a very long time to pump down because of low gas conductance. Vented screws use drilled holes to prevent gas pockets and speed pump-down. Vented screws provide a path for trapped air and surface contaminants such as water to be pumped away from blind-tapped holes, improving pump-down and reducing virtual leaks.” Now answer: Create one cold-call statement or question that would make a potential customer interested in finding a better fastener supplier for their vacuum application. Your answer should: Show that you understood the technical problem. Connect the problem to the customer’s business or process pain. Sound natural for a real phone conversation. Be specific, not generic. Avoid sounding like a textbook. Make the customer curious enough to continue the conversation. How to Apply Please send: Your resume. Header of the application must contain word: HIGH IQ. Your highest degree completed. Your answer to the test question above. One example of a difficult topic you researched and explained clearly. Confirmation that you can work 11 PM to 3 AM Philippine time, Monday evening to Friday evening. Your expected monthly salary. Applications without the test answer will not be considered. Work involving manufacturing, industrial markets, technical products, and advanced research. Opportunity to become a key intelligence partner for a business development team. title: GTM Systems & AI Operations Specialist
description: GTM Systems & AI Operations Specialist Reporting to: The Founder Working Hours: Full-time, UK business hours (Mon-Fri, 9:00am-5:30pm GMT/BST) Compensation: £1550 per month for 160 hours The Role This is a high-impact, full-time hire acting as the Founder’s right hand across systems, outbound, AI implementation, and light product work. The business has shifted. We no longer build outbound systems alone — we build outbound, CRM, automation, and AI enablement for clients and ourselves, with Claude Code as the mission control for everything we do. We use Claude Code every single day. Most of our processes live inside it. We are looking for someone AI-native, technically confident, and genuinely comfortable building with AI as the operating layer, not as a side tool. The single most important trait we are hiring for is the way this person thinks. The right mindset and critical thinking around AI is the foundation everything else is built on. Tool experience (Clay, Instantly, HeyReach) is teachable. The thinking - knowing how to direct AI, sense-check its output, and stay sharp instead of accepting whatever it gives you - is not. We would rather hire someone with a strong systems brain and genuine AI fluency, and teach them Clay from scratch, than hire a Clay expert who can’t think clearly with AI. The Founder will continue to lead strategy, sales, creative direction, and content. You will take ownership of: Building and running outbound systems (course signups, founder leads, client campaigns) using Claude Code, Clay, n8n, and connected APIs Implementing AI workflows and signal-based pipelines that reduce cost (less Clay credit dependency, more direct API + Claude orchestration) Light web/dev work — landing pages, platform tweaks, dashboards, internal tools — built inside Claude Code Helping deliver client builds (outbound, CRM, automation, AI enablement) Taking operational pressure off the Founder so he can focus on content and the inbound engine This is not an “operations-only” or “Clay specialist” role. You will be a systems thinker who speaks AI fluently, plays a critical role in revenue generation, and helps grow the business across multiple surfaces simultaneously. Core Responsibilities 1. Claude Code & AI Operations (Mission Control) - ~30% Operate inside the company’s Claude Code environment as your daily working surface Build, refine, and run AI-driven workflows, skills, and automations inside Claude Code Use Claude (and Claude Code specifically) to design and implement systems — not as a chat tool, but as an execution layer Prompt-engineer at a high standard. Generic AI output is not acceptable. Plug Claude into Clay, n8n, and external APIs to build cost-efficient signal-based pipelines Continuously look for ways to replace expensive tooling (e.g. high Clay credit spend) with direct API + Claude orchestration 2. Outbound Systems & Campaign Management - ~25% Build and run outbound systems to generate course signups and founder leads (our primary internal target) Manage outbound campaigns across: Instantly and Lemlist (email ) HeyReach (LinkedIn) Responsibilities include: Sequence setup and testing A/B testing and optimisation Domain/inbox rotation and deliverability Monitoring and handling replies Copy amendments (full copywriting = a plus) The Founder will set outbound strategy; you implement it on the tools 3. Clay & Data Systems - ~15–20% Build and manage Clay tables for prospecting, enrichment, segmentation Implement waterfall enrichment, AI columns, and scalable list-building Maintain clean, high-quality datasets Clay is still important — but we are moving toward Claude Code + Clay together, and toward replacing Clay-only steps with cheaper API-based alternatives where possible 4. Light Web / Platform / Dev Work - ~15% Spin up landing pages and lightweight websites (Claude Code-driven) Make tweaks and improvements to the platform we’re building (Next.js + Clerk + Supabase + Stripe stack) Build client-facing dashboards and internal tools Edit and maintain existing websites You do not need to be a senior engineer — you need to be confident shipping working code inside Claude Code and unafraid of touching a codebase or using AI to edit one. 5. Client Delivery Support - ~10–15% Build and manage outbound, CRM, and automation systems for client projects Support delivery of AI enablement work (Claude Code, automation, signal pipelines) for clients Ensure builds are reliable, scalable, and produce measurable results Potential to take increasing ownership of client-facing delivery over time Must-Have Skills & Experience Genuine AI literacy — confident, daily user of frontier AI models. Knows how to get a non-generic, production-grade result out of a model. Comfortable with Claude specifically. Claude Code (or willingness to become expert fast) — comfortable working inside an AI-driven workflow repo, running skills, executing prompts, editing files, working with version control Systems thinking — understands how outbound, CRM, automation, and AI connect at the framework level. Can design and implement an end-to-end system, not just operate one tool. Technical confidence — unbothered by code, APIs, terminals, and unfamiliar tools. Can read a stack trace, follow documentation, debug independently. Light dev capability — can ship landing pages, make site edits, and tweak existing apps with Claude Code’s help Ability to learn at speed — this is a fast-moving, ever-changing environment. The next six weeks (MFOS platform launch) are make-or-break. You will not have time to ramp slowly. Strong written English communication (client-ready level) Experience with B2B outbound / lead generation systems — at least foundational Clay experience (table building, AI columns, waterfall enrichment) — bonus, not required. We will teach it. Instantly, Lemlist, HeyReach experience n8n workflow building (especially self-hosted) Nice to Have Attio, Airtable, or similar CRMs Supabase / PostgreSQL Next.js / React / Tailwind — for platform work Git / version control Experience with API orchestration, especially using AI to coordinate between tools Experience working in a GTM agency, modern revenue-ops, or AI-native environment Ideal Candidate Profile The thinking is the role. Tool experience can be taught. Thinks clearly with AI — knows how to direct an AI to a sharp, non-generic, production-grade result. Pushes back on weak output rather than accepting it. Thinks like an operator AND a strategist Thorough and militant on providing work of a high standard AI-native — treats AI as an everyday operating layer, not a novelty. Comfortable being left alone with the tools to get a job done. Strong systems brain — sees how the pieces connect and how to build the next piece Moves fast, pivots fast, learns fast. Comfortable in a high-change, founder-led environment. Honest about gaps — proactively flags what they don’t know so we can move them forward quickly, instead of getting stuck quietly Comfortable following instructions when needed and operating independently when not Generates ideas, not just executes them Proactive, accountable, organised, and direct What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) Operating confidently inside Claude Code as the primary working environment Independently building and running: Outbound campaigns for course signups and founder leads Clay tables and enrichment workflows AI-driven signal pipelines (Claude Code + Clay + APIs) Light landing pages and platform tweaks Managing all active campaigns without daily oversight Contributing to course pipeline, platform growth, and client delivery Reducing Founder involvement in operations and delivery from 15–20 hours/week ?

description: We are looking for a skilled Podcast Audio Editor / Post-Production Producer based in the Philippines to help edit and polish podcast episodes for our growing content brands. Our shows include Forged to Rise, which focuses on faith, personal development, leadership, mindset, and transformation, as well as Thrive2Peak / Pro2Peak, which includes health, performance, clinical, and informational content. We need someone who does more than basic audio cleanup. The right person understands how to make a podcast sound professional, engaging, clear, and emotionally strong. You should know how to improve pacing, remove distractions, clean audio naturally, and help the listener stay engaged from beginning to end. This is a long-term role for the right editor. Responsibilities Your main responsibilities will include: Editing raw podcast recordings into polished final episodes. Cleaning background noise, clicks, mouth sounds, hum, echo, and other distractions. Balancing host and guest audio levels. Removing long pauses, repeated phrases, major filler words, false starts, and mistakes. Improving pacing and flow while keeping the conversation natural. Adding intro music, outro music, and any provided audio segments. Mastering final audio to professional podcast loudness standards. Exporting final files in MP3 and WAV format. Organizing files clearly in Google Drive. Communicating updates and questions clearly. Making revisions based on feedback. Optional: creating short audio/video clips, show notes, episode titles, or YouTube podcast edits if you have those skills. What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who: Has experience editing podcasts, interviews, sermons, coaching content, educational content, or long-form conversations. Has strong English listening comprehension. Understands pacing, storytelling, and listener retention. Can make audio sound clean without making it robotic or over-processed. Knows when to remove filler words and when to leave natural speech alone. Can work independently without needing constant supervision. Is organized, reliable, and deadline-driven. Is open to feedback and willing to learn our show style. Can work asynchronously with a team based in New Jersey, USA, Eastern Time. Required Skills You should be comfortable with at least one of the following tools: Adobe Audition Reaper Audacity Logic Pro Pro Tools Descript DaVinci Resolve Adobe Premiere Pro Audio skills should include: Noise reduction EQ Compression De-essing Breath and mouth-click cleanup Volume leveling Multitrack editing Intro/outro music placement Final mastering/export Experience with iZotope RX, Auphonic, Descript, Riverside, or video podcast editing is a plus. Content Style Our content has two main styles: 1. Faith / personal development / motivational content For this type of episode, the edit should preserve emotion, conviction, pauses, and impact. We do not want the conversation over-edited or made to sound unnatural. 2. Health / performance / clinical / informational content For this type of episode, the edit should prioritize clarity, clean structure, and easy listener understanding. Repetition and rambling should be tightened while preserving the meaning of what was said. The right editor should understand the difference between these two styles. Typical Episode Details Average raw episode length: 45–60 minutes Speakers: Usually 1 host + 1 guest Turnaround target: 48–72 hours per episode Work type: Part-time to start, with potential for long-term ongoing work Timezone: We are based in New Jersey, USA, Eastern Time Collaboration style: Mostly async using Google Drive, Loom, and messaging Pay We are open to either per-episode pay or a monthly arrangement after a trial period. Possible monthly arrangement after trial: depending on workload, speed, quality, and deliverables. Higher pay is possible for someone who can also handle video podcast editing, short-form clips, show notes, or publishing support. Paid Test Project Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test edit using a 10–15 minute raw podcast segment. The test will help us evaluate: Audio quality Pacing Naturalness of the edit Ability to remove distractions without over-editing Communication File delivery Deadline reliability Please do not apply if you are not willing to complete a paid test project. How to Apply Please start your application with this exact phrase: “I edit for listener retention.” Then answer the following questions: What podcast editing software do you use? How many podcasts or long-form episodes have you edited? Please send 2–3 samples of podcast episodes you edited. Do you have any before-and-after samples? What is your typical turnaround time for a 45–60 minute raw episode? What is your rate per episode? Are you available for ongoing weekly work? How do you d ---------- what to cut and what to keep in a conversation? Have you edited faith-based, motivational, coaching, health, medical, or educational content before? What are your normal working hours in Philippine time? Who This Role Is Not For This role is not for someone who: Only runs AI noise cleanup and exports the file. Has no podcast editing samples. Over-edits conversations until they sound unnatural. Cannot follow instructions. Misses deadlines without communication. Does not understand English well enough to edit for meaning and flow. Only focuses on technical cleanup and does not care about the listener experience. Final Note We are looking for a reliable long-term editor who can grow with our content brands. If you are skilled, organized, thoughtful, and care about creating high-quality podcast episodes, we would love to hear from you.
